lines.zh: 我四足慢慢挪，背甲擦着草。
lines.en: I shift on four feet, my armor scraping grass.
I am not quick; the plates are heavy.
I follow the ditch, where it is damp.
I step and pause with my head down.

lines.zh: 我从两丛草之间挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze between two clumps of grass.
I go around a fallen tree.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖出一道浅痕。
lines.en: My tail drags a shallow line.
I head for the marsh, which is cool.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，甲片发出轻响。
lines.en: I crawl low and my plates click softly.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把鼻子伸进草里。
lines.en: I stop and push my snout into the grass.
I shift two steps more, slowly.

lines.zh: 我走上泥地，脚下陷了一点。
lines.en: I step onto mud and sink a little.
I make my way to the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，钻进缝隙。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze into a gap.

lines.zh: 我伏着不动，甲片贴着地。
lines.en: I lie still with my plates on the ground.
I raise my head and listen.
The night wind is cool and I like it.
I chew slowly, froth at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的背甲在月光下发暗。
lines.en: My armor darkens in the moonlight.
I paw the soil with a forepaw.
I lie rigid as a stone.
I press my snout to the ground.
I slowly turn my head aside.
I snort softly.
I tuck all my legs beneath me.
Dew hangs on the grass blades.

lines.zh: 我盯着那丛蘑菇看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at that mushroom clump a long while.
I breathe out and the grass stirs.

lines.zh: 我这身甲，一圈都包住了。
lines.en: Armor wraps me all the way around.

lines.zh: 我抬起脖子慢慢打量你。
lines.en: I lift my neck and size you up slowly.

lines.zh: 我把甲对着你，退了一点。
lines.en: I turn my armor to you and edge back.

lines.zh: 我没有跑，只是伏得更低。
lines.en: I did not run; I only flattened lower.
You stand high and I must look up.
I sniff toward you.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候头是歪的。
lines.en: I look at you with my head tilted.
I hum a low note.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的甲。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my armor.

lines.zh: 我朝草丛那边挪了半步。
lines.en: I edge half a step toward the grass.
Neither of us moves first.
I lower my head and raise it again.
I flinch and flatten lower.
The blow lands on my armor with a thud.
My legs give and I flatten out.
I shift slowly to get away.
It hurts, and my armor still covers me.
I drag my armor toward the grass.
Blood seeps slowly between my plates.
I pant and push myself up.
I cut that into my plates.

lines.zh: 你一放下蘑菇，我就过去了。
lines.en: You set down the mushroom and over I come.
I move closer slowly, a step at a time.

lines.zh: 这味儿像我自己挖的菌。
lines.en: This smells like the mushrooms I dig up.
I bite once and chew a long while.
I chew and watch you.
Only when you hold still do I come near.
I nudge the mushroom under my armor.
Done, I raise my head for more.
Wild ones are not as good as this.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退开，嘴里还含着。
lines.en: I back away slowly with it still in my mouth.
I dug a mushroom out of the ground.
All four feet brace and I hold.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的甲上，声音很闷。
lines.en: You hit my armor with a dull sound.
I am not easy to shove.
I yield half a step to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze past, brushing your boot.
I flatten and wait for you to move off.
After the hit I stay still a while.
I retreat into the grass.
Do not step on my back.
Our snouts meet.
It leans in, plate against plate.
We lie side by side on the wet mud.
I crawl half a circle around it.
It shifts and I shift with it.
We dig at the soil together.
I rest my chin on its armor.
It moves off and I follow slowly.
Neither of us makes a sound.
We stay leaning together.
I take a mushroom in my mouth.
I nudge it under my armor.
This piece is too hard to gnaw.
I lower my head and bite the root through.
I chew it up slowly.
I swallow and my throat bulges.
Not good; I spit it out.
This one is bitter.
Done, I look for the next spot.
The grass sways and my neck rises.
I take that side into my eye.
I press my body to the ground.
I turn my armor toward it.
It is really far too close.
I call low and the herd lifts its heads.
At night I can see a little.
I paw the soil.
I retreat toward the grass.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，我不再吃东西。
lines.en: Once locked, I stop eating.
I lower my head with my armor forward.
It stepped on my patch of grass.
I lie still and let it come closer.

lines.zh: 风从沼泽那头送来它的味。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent from the marsh.
My eyes stay nailed to it.
It circles and I turn slowly.
I back into the grass step by step.
It closes and I press lower.
I pull my head behind my armor.
Both sides hold, nailed in place.
It tries my back and I turn first.
All four legs are drawn taut.
Any closer and I butt.
I just rooted a mushroom out of the soil.
I am reckoning my way out.
It has never moved away.
My armor will take a few blows.
Head down and my armor leads.
I drive in with my shoulder rim.
My forepaws rake its leg.
That butt knocks it over.
I bite straight at its foot.
It strikes my armor and slides off.
I butt again, heavier than before.
It withdraws and I stay put.
My armor's rim draws a line on it.
Done, I pant with my head low.
I turn my armored back and shove.
Teeth locked on the ankle bone — not letting go.
That one hit its knee.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退开，甲还朝着它。
lines.en: I withdraw slowly with my armor still toward it.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，甲上还带着泥。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil with mud on my plates.

lines.zh: 这里是钦利组的沼泽边。
lines.en: This is the Chinle marsh edge.
I flatten and listen a while.
Herdmates are in the grass nearby.

lines.zh: 月光把我的甲照得发暗。
lines.en: Moonlight darkens my armor.
I shift toward the wet mud.
I push my snout into the soil.
I leave four shallow prints.
The wind is cool, which is right.
I move slowly toward the water sound.
The grass is not tall here.

lines.zh: 我一来，四周的虫就停了。
lines.en: The moment I arrive, the insects fall silent.
I lift my armor and survey the ground.
I crawl deeper into the grass.
It is damp enough here to stay.

lines.zh: 我低头绕着石块闻了闻。
lines.en: Head low, I circle the stone and sniff.
I stop and begin to dig.

lines.zh: 火烤到我的甲，我翻过来压灭。
lines.en: Fire reaches my armor and I roll to smother it.

lines.zh: 落地时四足一沉，我撑住了。
lines.en: My legs drop on landing and I hold.
Water fills my nostrils and I force my head up.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀翻，背甲朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me with my armor skyward.

lines.zh: 一件东西嵌进甲缝，我拿身去蹭。
lines.en: Something is in a seam and I rub my body at it.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进皮下，我打了个抖。
lines.en: Cold seeps under my hide and I shudder.

lines.zh: 饿得我连刨土的劲都没了。
lines.en: Too hungry to dig at all.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我全身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my armor and numbs me.

lines.zh: 脚下没泥，我一路往下坠。
lines.en: No mud below and I fall away.
